onboarding.sleep_desc: Set your sleep schedule so notifications don't disturb you during the night.
onboarding.goal_desc_v2: Suggested from your weight (kg × 35 ml, kept within 1500–4000 ml). Tap to change it. If your doctor restricted fluids, follow that and enter the limit in Settings.
onboarding.emergency_desc_v2: Optional. If a high-priority dose is late we remind you and let you text this person with one tap. Nothing is sent without you.
onboarding.contact_incomplete: Enter a name and a phone number of at least 10 digits, or leave both empty.
onboarding.notifications_desc: Allow notifications so you don't miss doses and water breaks. We stay quiet during your sleep hours.
onboarding.notifications_denied: Permission not granted. You can turn it on later in phone settings.
onboarding.large_text_desc: Text and buttons get bigger. You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.exact_alarm_desc: One more step: Android needs a separate permission to deliver medication reminders on time. Allow it for AquaMed on the page that opens, then come back.
onboarding.follow_start: I'm here to follow a family member
onboarding.follow_name_desc: Your name is shown to the family member you pair with. You don't need to enter your own health details.
onboarding.follow_notifications_desc: Allow notifications so we can alert you when your family member is late with a dose.

pairing.title: Caregivers
pairing.settings_subtitle: Let a family member follow your doses
pairing.intro: A family member can see whether you took your medicines and gets a notification if a dose is late. You can also follow someone as a caregiver.
pairing.not_configured: Caregiver pairing isn't set up yet. It will be available in a future version.
pairing.shared_info: Shared: medicine name and dose, scheduled times, taken/skipped/late status. Up to 3 caregivers.
pairing.share_water_desc: Your caregivers see today's water intake
pairing.code_hint: Have your family member enter this code in their AquaMed app. Valid for 10 minutes, single use.
pairing.remove_confirm: The pairing with {{name}} will be removed and all shared data deleted.
pairing.late_alarm_info: If a dose isn't taken within {{min}} minutes, this phone alerts you — even if the other phone is off.
pairing.push_late_title: {{name}} hasn't taken the {{time}} dose for {{min}} min
pairing.err_invalid: Code not found. Check the digits.
pairing.err_expired: This code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
pairing.err_self: You can't enter your own code.
pairing.err_limit: Up to 3 caregivers can be added.
pairing.err_generic: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
pairing.late_delay_desc: If they miss a dose, when should we tell you?

pairing.plus_needed: To pair, you or {{name}} needs AquaMed Plus. Get Plus and you'll continue with the same code right away (the code is valid for 10 minutes).
pairing.paused: AquaMed Plus has ended, so this pairing is paused. It resumes as soon as either of you has Plus.

doctor_report.title: Doctor Report
doctor_report.paused_note: Paused; only recorded doses are counted
doctor_report.removed_note: Removed from the list; only recorded doses are counted
doctor_report.missed_hint: Planned: doses whose time has come. Missed: doses past their time that were not marked as taken or skipped. Adherence = taken / planned.
doctor_report.water_hint: The average is total fluid volume (all drinks) over days with entries.
doctor_report.over_limit_legend: ▲ Above the daily fluid limit set by the doctor.
doctor_report.source_note: This report is based on entries the user made in the AquaMed app.

interaction_schedule.title: Suggested times
interaction_schedule.intro: Suggested times so you take interacting medicines apart. Tap a medicine to change its times.
interaction_schedule.no_fit: No suitable time fits within your waking hours. Ask your doctor or pharmacist.
interaction_schedule.keep_apart: Keep at least {{hours}} hours between {{a}} and {{b}}.
interaction_schedule.not_by_timing: Taking these at different times does not prevent this interaction. Talk to your doctor.
interaction_schedule.apply_confirm: {{name}}: {{to}} instead of {{from}}. Reminders will be set for the new times.
interaction_schedule.apply_all_confirm: The times of these medicines will change to the suggested ones: {{names}}. Reminders will be set for the new times.
interaction_schedule.disclaimer: These suggestions are based on general information and are not medical advice. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before changing when you take your medicines.

account.title: Account & backup
account.settings_subtitle: Optional sign-in, your data is backed up to the cloud
account.intro: Optional. If you sign in, your data is backed up to the cloud and comes back when you change phones.
account.photos_note: Medication photos are not backed up; they stay on this phone only.
account.not_configured: Accounts are not set up yet.
account.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
account.forgot_sent: We sent a password reset link to {{email}}. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

account.auto_desc: Backed up automatically 5 minutes after a change and at least once a day.
account.restore_desc: Replaces this phone's data with the cloud copy
account.restore_body: The cloud backup will be loaded. The data on this phone will be DELETED and replaced by the backup.
account.no_backup: This account has no cloud backup.
account.cloud_info: There is a cloud backup from {{date}} ({{device}}).

account.delete_desc: Deletes the cloud backup, family pairings and the account; data on this phone stays
account.delete_body: Your cloud backup, family pairings and account will be permanently deleted. Data on this phone is not deleted.

account.err_weak_password: Password too weak: use at least 6 characters.
account.err_network: No internet connection. Try again when you're online.
account.err_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
account.err_recent_login: For security you need to sign in again. Sign out, sign in, then try again.
account.err_not_configured: This sign-in method is not set up yet.
account.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.choice_body: There is a cloud backup from {{date}} ({{device}}). Automatic backup is on hold until you choose, so the cloud copy isn’t overwritten.
account.keep_phone_body: This phone’s data will overwrite the cloud backup. The old cloud backup can’t be brought back.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.error_bp_order: Systolic must be higher than diastolic.
measurements.error_future: You can't pick a time in the future.
